blind_read: The monkey hoisted a bucket to a cloud, retrieved a green ticket and applauded.

evidence.observation: The bucket travels up the right side of the crane while the monkey pulls the rope on the left. A little question card is visible just above the bucket before it reaches the cloud.
The monkey displays a green check card at face height, then brings its hands together. The card and hardware remain distinct from the teal coat and the bucket returns to the floor.
